contributors.name: Yoḥanān VIII Hormezd, Chaldean Patriarch of Babylon, 1760-1838
Milūs, Ḥannā Īliyā, Bishop of ʻAqrah, 1831-1908
Yawsep VI ʼOdo, Patriarch of the Chaldeans, 1790-1878
Yūsuf ʻImmānūʼīl II Tūmā, Patriarch of Babylon, 1852-1947
ʻAbd al-Aḥad, Chaldean Metropolitan of Āmid, -1727

contents.contents: Succession of patriarchs of the East, by Jājā, fol. 1r-13r; autobiography of Yoḥanān VIII and other historical excerpts, including the names of churches in Mosul that have become mosques, fol. 15r-29v; account of al-Maʼmūn and his construction of a church near his palace, fol. 30r-34v; three papal bulls, fol. 35r-43v; letter of Pius IX, fol. 44r-62v; letter of the people of Malabar to Yoḥanān VIII, fol. 63r-67r; Milūs's letter from Malabar to the Chaldeans of Mosul and Baghdad, fol. 68r-83r; Bartatar's letter to the Chaldeans of Mosul, fol. 84r-94r; ʻAbd al-Aḥad's life of Joseph I ( Tarjamat Yūsuf al-Awwal baṭriyark al-Kaldān ) with other letters and historical excerpts, fol. 95r-109r; letters exchanged between Yūsuf VI and the people of Malabar, fol. 110r-124v; list of Chaldean fasts and feasts with other ecclesiological and liturgical excerpts, including lists of the popes, fol. 125r-140v; succession of the popes, by Ḥaddād, fol. 141r-147v; Yūsuf VI and the issue of Malabar, by Korolevsky, translated by Abūnā, fol. 149r-167r; statistics on the Chaldean Church in 1913 CE, by Tüfenkçi, fol. 168r-178v; Chabot's treatise al-Lughāt al-Ārāmīyah wa-ādābuhā ( Les langues et les littératures araméennes ), translated by Lawrence, with a note on the apparition of Mary in Cairo in 1968 CE and a statement from the Congregation for the Propagation of the Faith on the Eastern liturgies, fol. 179r-213v; Christian terms in Arabic, by al-Sāmarrāʼī, with a variety of other excerpts, fol. 214r-243v; the decree of Pilate on the arrest, trial, and death of Jesus, translated from English, with a note on the calculation of Easter and a legal text granting permission for Christians to bury their dead, fol. 244r-252v; prophecies of Jesus in the Old Testament, fol. 253r-259r; table of contents, fol. 259v-262v; letters, including a letter from Kabūshī to al-Bakr, fol. 263r-265v
contents.notes: Postage stamp issued by the Republic of Iraq in honor of Kabūshī, fol. 263v
